a.speaker: Monday, November 1, 2027
a.text:
Breakfast. {partner.name} is late for the early shift and eating standing up. {elder.name} called from the care home in Forest Grove to complain about the oatmeal. {teen.name} is texting under the table. {child.name} wants to know why the sky looked green in a dream.

"I'll be home by seven," you say, and grab your keys, and the day is ordinary all the way to dusk.
